column1: # Core-plugin list — the single declarative source naming the compiler's core
# Wasm plugins and whether the CLI binary embeds each. Every plugin listed is
# built and stamped at the compiler's version, has its Plugin entity generated
# and is published with each compiler release; a plugin the binary does not
# embed differs from the rest only there. This file is read by the embedded
# package (to build its registry table, from the rows it embeds) and, through
# scripts/lib/core-plugins.sh, by the guest build, the freshness and drift
# checks, the overlay check, the entity generation and the release workflow, so
# the set is authored exactly once and no parallel list can drift from it.
# One row per core plugin. Fields are tab-separated; blank lines and lines
# beginning with # are ignored. Fields:
#   socket      plugin socket (provider, linter, ...) — first URI path segment
#   name        plugin name — second URI path segment and artifact basename
#   sourcePath  guest source directory, relative to the aggrega-cli module root
#   toolchain   guest toolchain: go or rust
#   extraRoots  comma-separated extra source roots for the freshness check
#               (e.g. a local SDK crate); empty for go guests
#   embed       empty or absent: the binary embeds the plugin; `no`: it is
#               built, stamped, generated and published, and never embedded.
#               No other value is accepted. Written only where it is `no`.
# The registry key is the plugin's bare identity {socket}/{name}. An embedded
# plugin's artifacts are plugins/{name}.wasm.gz, plugins/{name}.describe.json and
# plugins/{name}.plugin.yaml; a plugin the binary does not embed has the same
# three under published-only/, which nothing embeds.
